scope: Offline byte reconstruction only. Each program concatenates the independently retained original body hex and the shown catch/binary-scan wrapper, then matches the original capture source_sha256 exactly. These are recovered input bytes, not newly executed native programs, provider validation, or Rust test outcomes. Bodies and provider associations remain separate.

jim-unset.producer: Exact wrapper bytes recovered only by agreement with the original whole-input digest; no original producer program is retained for this purpose.

dynamic-catch.producer: Exact wrapper bytes recovered only by agreement with the original whole-input digest; no original producer program is retained for this purpose.
